description: DHCP server scope utilization monitoring (internal DCIs over DHCP.Scopes instance discovery), works with agent-based (Kea, dnsmasq, Windows DHCP Server) and network device driver based (MikroTik, Cisco IOS, Dell DNOS) DHCP servers.

templates.name: DHCP Server
templates.comments:
Scope utilization monitoring for DHCP servers.

Auto-binds to nodes with the "DHCP server" capability. The capability is detected during configuration poll when DHCP server information is available from:
  * agent - Kea or dnsmasq subagent, or winnt subagent on Windows DHCP Server (DHCP.Scopes table);
  * network device driver - MikroTik RouterOS and Cisco IOS DHCP server via SSH, Dell PowerConnect / N-series (DNOS) via SNMP.

All DCIs use internal origin, so the same template works for any source. One DCI per scope is created by instance discovery over internal table DHCP.Scopes; instance is scope ID (network prefix in address/bits form).

Scope information is cached by the server for 30 seconds, so all DCIs of a node collected at the same time result in a single request to the agent or device.

Threshold: utilization at or above 90% for 2 consecutive polls generates SYS_THRESHOLD_REACHED.

dcis.name: DHCP.Scope.Utilization({instance})
dcis.comments: Server-side internal metric calculated from DHCP scope information that the server reads from the node's agent (DHCP.Scopes agent table) or network device driver (SNMP or SSH, depending on device). Percentage of addresses available for leasing that are currently leased.

dcis.name: DHCP.Scope.Used({instance})
dcis.comments: Server-side internal metric calculated from DHCP scope information that the server reads from the node's agent (DHCP.Scopes agent table) or network device driver (SNMP or SSH, depending on device).

dcis.name: DHCP.Scope.Free({instance})
dcis.comments: Server-side internal metric calculated from DHCP scope information that the server reads from the node's agent (DHCP.Scopes agent table) or network device driver (SNMP or SSH, depending on device).

dcis.name: DHCP.Scope.Total({instance})
dcis.comments: Server-side internal metric calculated from DHCP scope information that the server reads from the node's agent (DHCP.Scopes agent table) or network device driver (SNMP or SSH, depending on device). Number of addresses available for leasing (pool size).
